# Car Wash — interactive prototype

Open `index.html` to review the three-turn experience. One continuous silent 1248×720, 16 fps video pauses at the source clip boundaries: 0, 8.0625, 15.875, and 23.9375 seconds. The middle clean clip contains 125 frames, so its turn is 7.8125 seconds long. Source files remain untouched; `../build.py` rebuilds the master, poster, and EDL.

The compact action button, `W` / `E` / `W` shortcuts, and clickable `01`–`03` bars play the prerecorded turns. `R` restarts. These keys are editorial playback cues based on visible actions, not a claim about the model's original conditioning prompts. No branches or live inference are implied.
